verdicts.reason: Both lose the original's identity: the colourful 'ART' letterforms are reduced to unrecognisable cropped fragments (a black 'T' slab, pink stripes, a yellow corner), and the headline sits almost against the left edge. In A, a cropped strip of pink stripe peeks out right under 'LIFE.' and a beige block is jammed beneath the text, so the graphics feel scattered and close to colliding. B keeps the stripes as one coherent block above the copy, but it leaves a large empty white area below a stray beige bar, so the lower half looks unbalanced.
